dateline: BTS closed three sold-out La Plata nights (Oct 21, 23, 24) of the ARIRANG World Tour; São Paulo is next on the Latin American leg.
heroHeadline: Day 4,882: BTS Close Argentina Debut With Promise to Return
heroSubtitle: October 25, 2026 is Day 4,882 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS finished three nights at Estadio Único in La Plata, singing 'Muchachos' on night two and wearing Argentina jerseys on the final night, with 'Lost' and 'Cypher Pt. 4' as surprise songs.
